title: Button size, shape and placement follow Apple HIG
context: Header and dialog controls were 32px and each page picked its own size, below HIG's 44pt touch target.
decision: Button `icon` size is 44x44 (36 under `pointer: fine`) with no outline and a glass shell. Back is RiArrowLeftSLine and close is RiCloseLine. A page's primary action and a form submit use `lg`; an in-section action and a dialog footer action use `default`; list rows use `wide`. Chips take the segmented chip style with a 44px hit area. The recording panel's move buttons are a known exception, to be measured first; the nav FAB and the landing CTAButton own their sizes.

alternatives.reason: Controls stay under the touch target and inconsistent across pages.
Dense desktop layouts and the recording panel need smaller hit areas, hence the pointer: fine rule and the exceptions.

consequences: A later shard implements this; the record only fixes the rules.
Dialog header controls and page layouts need re-checking at the new size.
revisitTriggers: The recording panel measurement shows the move buttons can meet 44px.
